t: You are on the Strand, where Cecil House once stood. In fact there were two mansions of that name. The first, a sixteenth-century house on the north side, stood where the Strand Palace Hotel is now. The second, built in the early seventeenth century opposite, stood where Shell Mex House is today. William Cecil, Lord Burghley, lived at Cecil House. He was Elizabeth I's chief adviser for most of her reign, twice Secretary of State and Lord High Treasurer from 1572.
